name: abyssal-garden-rebuild
description: A from-scratch rebuild of Noniv's Abyssal Garden, a procedural WebGPU underwater world

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run build:harness && node tests/browser/boot.mjs && node tests/browser/post.mjs && node tests/browser/bakes.mjs && node tests/browser/opaque.mjs && node tests/browser/scene.mjs && node tests/browser/frame.mjs && node tests/browser/generator.mjs && node tests/browser/frame.mjs 0,1,2 --generated && node tests/browser/controls.mjs && node tests/browser/shell.mjs && node tests/browser/body.mjs
